verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's marketing page documents first-party invoicing: users can generate invoices for customers and get paid online. Nothing in the pack shows automatic payment reminders, and the invoice evidence is a single marketing line with no in-depth docs. missing for 10: automatic reminders, documentation of hosted invoice pages and their payment flow, in-depth first-party invoicing docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders

citations.quote: Generate professional invoices for your customers and get paid from anywhere.
